answer: Vouching with shared liability hardens an agent economy against sybils: a fresh key only gains standing when an established member co-signs its admission, and the voucher absorbs part of any penalty the protege later earns by cheating. Across the desert of forged accounts, every dune of fake keys still needs a respectable sponsor whose own reputation is the shale bed under the vote, so honest members refuse bulk endorsements. Each clone then costs a complicit insider willing to mortgage its standing, and a flashy plume of registrations collapses without sponsors.
